dez.translation: abbr. dezembro (Portuguese=December) （葡萄牙语）十二月; diethyl zinc 二乙基锌

dezhnev, cape.translation: 杰日尼奥夫角(俄罗斯东北部的海角)[亦作East Cape]

dezincification.definition:
n. The act or process of freeing from zinc; also, the
   condition resulting from the removal of zinc.

dezincify.definition: v. t. To deprive of, or free from, zinc.
dezincify.translation: 除锌, 脱锌, 去锌
